idea-plugin.name: Local AI Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Local AI Commit Generator for IntelliJ IDEA

Generates structured, conventional commit messages using local LLMs (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp) via JetBrains Koog.

  • Multi-Root Git Support: Full hierarchical visualization, directory collapsing, and diff extraction for main projects and nested submodules.
  • Local LLM Direct Connection: Connect directly to your local LLM (defaults to Ollama on http://localhost:11434) with real-time streaming tokens.
  • Smart Token Budgeting & Chunking: Bottom-up directory tree chunking based on dynamically computed context window limits with token streaming per chunk.
  • Repetition Loop Detection: Real-time loop prevention and deduplication during token streaming.
  • Intelligent File & Media Filtering: Automatically skips binary files, images, videos, audio, and archives while preserving relevant SVG assets.
  • Git Context Actions: Show diff, jump to source, rollback changes, stage to VCS, add to .gitignore, delete untracked files, and copy file paths.
  • Pre-Commit Actions: Optional rearrange code, reformat code, and optimize imports before committing.
